basis: Both completed component studies failed their original selection and remain rejected. In matched pre-2026 common-five accounts, corrected support wealth was 4.425747506998332, observed readiness 5.170172053341862, reserved-cash completion 4.692563367277561, and incumbent 5.503243377936298. Readiness changes the first observable support-estimation opportunity; completion changes only the size of an already-selected fresh admission. These separate decision mechanisms motivate one prospective interaction test, not an assumption of additive profits or a retrospective extension of either old grid. Completion also slightly reduced leader-removal wealth relative to the corrected parent; adverse interactions must remain visible.
hypothesis: An expanding observed-history support estimate and residual completion may jointly repair distinct admission delays and funding shortfalls. They can instead amplify noisy early commitments and change actual NAV risk, protection and recovery paths. Evaluate one jointly executed candidate, never splice the favorable pools, dates, fills or returns of the components.
implementation: Reuse the existing observed_readiness.Owner's initialized SupportIntent and its exact rolling-20 estimator with Config.fast minimum, fresh quote/volume readiness and unchanged current eligibility. Apply the existing admission_budget_completion.Owner decision method to that initialized inner owner. Reuse both modules without changing their source or frozen contracts. Initialize once before the first observation; never replace state during a run. All actual account state and protective economic obligations belong to that one inner owner.
funding: Preserve every original parent purchase before computing residual resources. Complete only already-selected fresh symbols, in the existing score/symbol order, within actual cash, current-cap NAV headroom, original global stop-risk, name and sector constraints. No extra symbols, held-position enlargement beyond the parent, sale-proceeds assumptions, changes to stops or risk caps, or new orders solely for completion. No completion on protected closes. Intent traces remain distinct from actual fills.
unchanged: All production files, old research families/contracts, parameters, original selection formula, data, universe, costs, next-open execution, T+1, liquidity, minimum lot/materiality, protective retries, partial-sale economic ceilings and actual-NAV history remain unchanged. No swap, fast-readmission or forecast mechanism is combined. No numerical parameter is added or tuned. Removed securities remain absent from all inputs. No pre-2023 history is added.
selection: Exactly one empty-parameter candidate under the unchanged finite_study selector, ending 2025-12-31, with the same union, common-five and joint optical-leader-removal scopes, incumbent wealth/drawdown/fill deficits, objective and tie-breaks. A core pass is not original economic acceptance.
evaluation: Use the same candidate for the unchanged full, bull, late-June-through-August, July-August and retrospective-2026 windows. Native references, original pools, actual-contributor and industry removals, sizes/subsets, cost/delay, parameter and causal-prefix requirements remain necessary before normal main delivery. Do not rerun completed component studies.
verification: actual observed-history readiness without fabricated initial true range
same owner and one NAV update per close
joint policy agrees with completion when support estimators coincide
protected and partially filled obligations unchanged
limitations: 2026 has been repeatedly observed and is retrospective. Adjusted economic units are not a verified actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger. This new interaction hypothesis cannot establish universal superiority or future profits. Failed or invalid evidence is preserved, not promoted.
